bajada: OpenAI ha activado ChatGPT Wallet, permitiendo a sus agentes realizar compras automáticas con aprobación del usuario. La billetera está disponible para suscriptores de ChatGPT Pro en EE.UU. con tarjetas de crédito elegibles, marcando un paso importante hacia la autonomía de los agentes de IA.

title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
title_es: Nvidia presuntamente ingenió escasez de GPUs para beneficiarse
bajada: Reportes sugieren que Nvidia financió startups de IA específicamente para asegurar que compraran sus GPUs, creando una escasez artificial. Esta práctica podría tener implicaciones antimonopolio significativas para la empresa.
bajada_en: Reports suggest Nvidia funded AI startups specifically to ensure they purchased its GPUs, creating artificial scarcity. This practice could have significant antitrust implications for the company.

title: Everything That Led to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s Fall
summary: Jensen Huang is gone from Nvidia, the chipmaker he co-founded 33 years ago. The origins of that downfall go back to the 2010s—to when Alice Huang, one of the women with whom he allegedly had an affair, was setting herself up to become a major Nvidia customer. Their relationship went unnoticed for a long time, but then it became just one element in a growing array of scandals around Jensen that eventually led to his resignation on Wednesday. As the drama widened, it came to include two more alleged affairs, a confrontation at Jensen’s home and a fateful board meeting. Below, you’ll find a curated timeline of what happened.

title: The Fallout from Jensen’s Downfall
summary: Welcome, Weekenders!Jexit, as I’d like to christen Huang’s departure from Nvidia, is an ugly matter, an implosion with fallout across continents and several different industries. No one irradiated by it walks away a picture of good health.Huang obfuscated the truth,promising senior executives at his companythat he’d had just the one affair, with Alice Huang, the former executive at Megaspeed, a major Nvidia customer. But that wasn’t the case. He reportedly had at least two others, including one with a direct report.Nvidia’s board almost didn’t act and only did so on the insistence of the company’s general counsel, Tim Teter. I’m not surprised. The boardis dominatedby people who’ve known Huang for decades. And there was not even a board chair.The friendships Huang thought he had in Washington weren’t nearly enough to save him, a reminder of the fickleness of politics as Silicon Valley goes through the necessary course correction to win influence with the ascendant left. (Alex Karp is a Democrat again, did youhear?) Indeed, it looks pretty obvious that some factions within Trump-led Washington worked against Huang. Many of the reporters who have been most active in the last week are in Washington.Some U.S. authorities say the former Megaspeed executive was a spy. Was she? Morereportsin recent days cast doubt on whether she really was. No matter. The mere implication was a useful weapon to wield against Huang.The spy-who-loved-him situation was catnip for reporters, but I don’t want to hand out laurels to the media. Huang’s bullying tendencies went underhighlighted for years—first because Nvidia was too complex and confusing to cover, and then because of Huang’s presentation of himself as a nerdish, articulate poster boy for the AI age. It makes me wonder who else is escaping close coverage as the tech landscape continues to widen and morph.Throughout Jexit, Huang has maintained a sizable base of support in Silicon Valley. bajada: Investigadores han utilizado IA para transcribir y decodificar los cuadernos del matemático Kurt Gödel, revelando cientos de teoremas demostrados previamente ocultos. Este descubrimiento demuestra el potencial de la IA en investigación histórica y matemática.

title: alibaba /open-code-review
summary: OpenCodeReview English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский What is Open Code Review? Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. Visit the official website for more details. Benchmark Compared to general-purpose agents (Claude Code), Open Code Review achieves significantly higher Precision and F1 with the same underlying model, while consuming only ~1/9 of the tokens and completing reviews faster. Note that its Recall is lower than general-purpose agents — a deliberate trade-off favoring precision over noise. A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers ( 1,505 annotated ground-truth issues). Explore the AACR-Bench dataset on Hugging Face . Metric What it measures Why it matters F1 Harmonic mean of precision and recall Best single number for overall review quality Precision Proportion of reported issues that are real defects Higher = fewer false alarms to triage Recall Proportion of real defects that are found Higher = fewer issues slip through review Avg Time Wall-clock time per review Matters for CI pipeline latency Avg Token Total
